objects.description: Deprecated enum for JPEG 2000 RSIZ capabilities/profile identifiers. Superseded by RSIZ, OPJ_PROFILE_* and OPJ_EXTENSION_* macros.
Deprecated enum for Digital Cinema operation modes used by older compliance checks.
Enum of JPEG 2000 progression orderings used in encoding/decoding and stream description.
Enum of supported image color spaces for opj_image_t.
Enum of supported codec container formats used to create compressors/decompressors.

objects.definition: typedef void (*opj_msg_callback)(const char *msg, void *client_data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for info/warning/error callbacks that receive a message and user data.
Structure describing a single progression order change (POC) segment for encoding, with ranges and temporary state.
Comprehensive encoder configuration parameters, including tiling, rates, resolutions, code-blocks, ROI, precincts, JPWL, cinema profile, and optional MCT matrix data.
Decoder parameters for resolution/layer reduction, decode area, tile selection, formats, verbosity and JPWL options.

objects.definition: typedef void * opj_codec_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle type for a JPEG 2000 codec (encoder or decoder). Created by opj_create_decompress/opj_create_compress and destroyed by opj_destroy_codec.

objects.definition:
typedef OPJ_SIZE_T(* opj_stream_read_fn)(void * p_buffer, OPJ_SIZE_T p_nb_bytes,
        void * p_user_data) ;
objects.description: Function pointer type for stream read callback: fills p_buffer with up to p_nb_bytes; returns bytes read.

objects.definition:
typedef OPJ_SIZE_T(* opj_stream_write_fn)(void * p_buffer,
        OPJ_SIZE_T p_nb_bytes, void * p_user_data) ;
objects.description: Function pointer type for stream write callback: writes p_nb_bytes from p_buffer; returns bytes written.

objects.definition:
typedef OPJ_OFF_T(* opj_stream_skip_fn)(OPJ_OFF_T p_nb_bytes,
                                        void * p_user_data) ;
objects.description: Function pointer type for stream skip callback: skip forward p_nb_bytes; returns actual skipped offset or -1 on EOF.

objects.definition:
typedef OPJ_BOOL(* opj_stream_seek_fn)(OPJ_OFF_T p_nb_bytes,
                                       void * p_user_data) ;
objects.description: Function pointer type for stream seek callback: absolute seek from start (SEEK_SET semantics).

objects.definition: typedef void (* opj_stream_free_user_data_fn)(void * p_user_data) ;
objects.description: Function pointer type to free user data associated with a stream when it is destroyed.

objects.definition: typedef void * opj_stream_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle type for an I/O stream used by the codec. Create with opj_stream_default_create/opj_stream_create or file helpers; destroy with opj_stream_destroy.
Describes a single image component (sampling, geometry, precision/sign, decoded state) and its sample buffer.
Top-level image object carrying reference grid extents, component count, color space, components array, and optional ICC profile.
Component parameter descriptor used to create opj_image_t instances (sampling, geometry, precision, signedness).
Packet-level index entry (positions and distortion) for codestream introspection.
Marker segment index entry (type, position, length) for codestream/JP2 introspection.
Tile-part info (byte ranges and packet counts) used by legacy codestream info APIs.
Legacy per-tile information structure for detailed dump/index of codestreams (packet info, precincts, markers, tile-parts).
Legacy global codestream information structure containing image size, tiling, progression, markers, and per-tile details.
Per-component coding parameter info (code-blocks, transform, quantization, ROI, precincts) for codestream reporting.
V2 per-tile info summary for codestream info v2: coding style, progression, layers, MCT, and component coding params.
Modern codestream information structure with tiling geometry, component count, and default/per-tile coding info. Freed with opj_destroy_cstr_info().
Tile-part index entry with byte offsets in the codestream.
Per-tile index: tile-parts array, optional markers, and packet index entries for codestream indexing.
Global codestream index: SOC/SOT header bounds, size, optional markers and per-tile indices. Destroyed with opj_destroy_cstr_index().
Placeholder JP2 metadata structure (experimental).
Placeholder JP2 index structure (experimental).

objects.definition: typedef int OPJ_BOOL;
objects.description: Boolean typedef used throughout the API. OPJ_TRUE = 1, OPJ_FALSE = 0.

objects.definition: typedef char          OPJ_CHAR;
objects.description: Character typedef used by the API for portability.

objects.definition: typedef float         OPJ_FLOAT32;
objects.description: 32-bit float typedef used by the API.

objects.definition: typedef double        OPJ_FLOAT64;
objects.description: 64-bit float typedef used by the API.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned char OPJ_BYTE;
objects.description: 8-bit byte typedef used by the API.

objects.definition: typedef int8_t   OPJ_INT8;
objects.description: Signed 8-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef uint8_t  OPJ_UINT8;
objects.description: Unsigned 8-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef int16_t  OPJ_INT16;
objects.description: Signed 16-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef uint16_t OPJ_UINT16;
objects.description: Unsigned 16-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef int32_t  OPJ_INT32;
objects.description: Signed 32-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t OPJ_UINT32;
objects.description: Unsigned 32-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef int64_t  OPJ_INT64;
objects.description: Signed 64-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef uint64_t OPJ_UINT64;
objects.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer typedef.

objects.definition: typedef int64_t  OPJ_OFF_T; /* 64-bit file offset type */
objects.description: 64-bit file offset typedef used by stream callbacks and indexing.

objects.definition: typedef size_t   OPJ_SIZE_T;
objects.description: Size type typedef used in buffer/stream APIs.
Note: This is not a distinct type; pointer-to-pointer appears in APIs. No additional definition.

functions.name: opj_version
functions.signature: OPJ_API const char * OPJ_CALLCONV opj_version(void);
functions.description: Returns the OpenJPEG library version string. Use to log or display the runtime version of the linked library.
requirements: No parameters.
Returned pointer is a constant, do not modify or free.

functions.name: opj_image_create
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_image_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_image_create(OPJ_UINT32 numcmpts, opj_image_cmptparm_t *cmptparms, OPJ_COLOR_SPACE clrspc);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes an image with the specified number of components and component parameters in the given color space.
requirements: cmptparms must point to an array of at least numcmpts elements.
numcmpts should match the number of entries in cmptparms.
Returns NULL on allocation/initialization failure; caller must check.
The returned image must be freed with opj_image_destroy.

functions.name: opj_image_destroy
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_image_destroy(opj_image_t *image);
functions.description: Deallocates resources associated with an image created by OpenJPEG (e.g., opj_image_create/opj_image_tile_create).
requirements: image may be NULL (unknown from header; safe to pass pointer returned by OpenJPEG creators).
Do not use image after calling this function.
Only pass images allocated by OpenJPEG APIs.

functions.name: opj_image_tile_create
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_image_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_image_tile_create(OPJ_UINT32 numcmpts, opj_image_cmptparm_t *cmptparms, OPJ_COLOR_SPACE clrspc);
functions.description: Creates an image structure for tiled processing without allocating component pixel buffers (comps[].data). Useful for tile-based encode workflows.
requirements: cmptparms must point to an array of at least numcmpts elements.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.
Component data buffers must be allocated separately (e.g., via opj_image_data_alloc) before use.
The returned image must be freed with opj_image_destroy.

functions.name: opj_image_data_alloc
functions.signature: OPJ_API void* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_image_data_alloc(OPJ_SIZE_T size);
functions.description: Allocates a raw byte buffer suitable for opj_image_t->comps[].data. To be paired with opj_image_data_free.
requirements: size is the number of bytes to allocate; must be large enough for the intended component data.
Returns NULL on allocation failure; caller must check.
Memory must be freed with opj_image_data_free.

functions.name: opj_image_data_free
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_image_data_free(void* ptr);
functions.description: Frees a buffer allocated by opj_image_data_alloc.
requirements: ptr must be a pointer returned by opj_image_data_alloc (or NULL).
Do not double-free.

functions.name: opj_stream_default_create
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_stream_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_default_create(OPJ_BOOL p_is_input);
functions.description: Creates an abstract stream with default internal buffering, initialized for input or output direction only. No I/O callbacks are set by default.
requirements: p_is_input must be OPJ_STREAM_READ (OPJ_TRUE) for input streams or OPJ_STREAM_WRITE (OPJ_FALSE) for output streams.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.
Caller must later set appropriate callbacks (read/write/skip/seek) and user data as needed.
Destroy with opj_stream_destroy.

functions.name: opj_stream_create
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_stream_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_create(OPJ_SIZE_T p_buffer_size, OPJ_BOOL p_is_input);
functions.description: Creates an abstract stream with a specified internal buffer size, initialized for input or output direction. Does not set I/O callbacks.
requirements: p_buffer_size is the internal chunk/buffer size (exact semantics not documented).
p_is_input must be OPJ_TRUE for input or OPJ_FALSE for output.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.
Caller must set callbacks and user data before use.
Destroy with opj_stream_destroy.

functions.name: opj_stream_destroy
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_destroy(opj_stream_t* p_stream);
functions.description: Destroys a stream object created by opj_stream_create/opj_stream_default_create. It does not close underlying user I/O; the user remains responsible for that.
requirements: p_stream may be NULL (unknown from header).
If user data was set with a free callback via opj_stream_set_user_data, that callback will be invoked.
Do not use the stream after destruction.

functions.name: opj_stream_set_read_function
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_set_read_function(opj_stream_t* p_stream, opj_stream_read_fn p_function);
functions.description: Sets the read callback for an input stream. The callback fills a buffer and returns the number of bytes read, with -1 signaling end of stream per typedef docs (note signed/size mismatch; follow project conventions).
requirements: p_stream must be a valid stream created with input direction.
p_function must follow signature: OPJ_SIZE_T (*)(void*, OPJ_SIZE_T, void*). Returns number of bytes read; -1 signals EOS (per comment).
User data must be set separately via opj_stream_set_user_data if needed.

functions.name: opj_stream_set_write_function
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_set_write_function(opj_stream_t* p_stream, opj_stream_write_fn p_function);
functions.description: Sets the write callback for an output stream.
requirements: p_stream must be a valid stream created with output direction.
p_function must follow signature: OPJ_SIZE_T (*)(void*, OPJ_SIZE_T, void*), returning number of bytes written.

functions.name: opj_stream_set_skip_function
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_set_skip_function(opj_stream_t* p_stream, opj_stream_skip_fn p_function);
functions.description: Sets the skip callback for a stream, used to advance by a number of bytes.
requirements: p_stream must be valid.
p_function must follow signature: OPJ_OFF_T (*)(OPJ_OFF_T, void*), returning the number of bytes actually skipped.

functions.name: opj_stream_set_seek_function
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_set_seek_function(opj_stream_t* p_stream, opj_stream_seek_fn p_function);
functions.description: Sets the seek callback for a stream, making it seekable with SEEK_SET semantics.
requirements: p_stream must be valid.
p_function must follow signature: OPJ_BOOL (*)(OPJ_OFF_T, void*), returning OPJ_TRUE on success.
Provide consistent skip/seek behaviour if both are set.

functions.name: opj_stream_set_user_data
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_set_user_data(opj_stream_t* p_stream, void * p_data, opj_stream_free_user_data_fn p_function);
functions.description: Associates user data with a stream and an optional destructor to be called by opj_stream_destroy.
requirements: p_stream must be valid.
p_data is an opaque pointer passed to callbacks.
p_function, if non-NULL, must be safe to call at opj_stream_destroy time to free p_data.

functions.name: opj_stream_set_user_data_length
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_set_user_data_length(opj_stream_t* p_stream, OPJ_UINT64 data_length);
functions.description: Sets the total length of the underlying data for the stream (used by the codec).
requirements: p_stream must be valid.
data_length should reflect the actual length of the user data source or 0 if unknown.

functions.name: opj_stream_create_default_file_stream
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_stream_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_create_default_file_stream(const char *fname, OPJ_BOOL p_is_read_stream);
functions.description: Helper to create a file-backed stream with default parameters for reading or writing based on a filename.
requirements: fname must be a valid, accessible path.
p_is_read_stream must be OPJ_TRUE for read or OPJ_FALSE for write.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.
Destroy with opj_stream_destroy when done. Underlying file is managed by the helper (details not explicitly documented).

functions.name: opj_stream_create_file_stream
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_stream_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_stream_create_file_stream(const char *fname, OPJ_SIZE_T p_buffer_size, OPJ_BOOL p_is_read_stream);
functions.description: Helper to create a file-backed stream with a specified internal buffer size for reading or writing.
requirements: fname must be a valid, accessible path.
p_buffer_size is the internal chunk size used to stream.
p_is_read_stream must be OPJ_TRUE for read or OPJ_FALSE for write.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.
Destroy with opj_stream_destroy when done.

functions.name: opj_set_info_handler
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_info_handler(opj_codec_t * p_codec, opj_msg_callback p_callback, void * p_user_data);
functions.description: Registers an info-level message callback for a codec instance.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid codec handle.
p_callback must match typedef void (*)(const char*, void*).
p_user_data is passed to the callback.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success; caller must check.

functions.name: opj_set_warning_handler
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_warning_handler(opj_codec_t * p_codec, opj_msg_callback p_callback, void * p_user_data);
functions.description: Registers a warning-level message callback for a codec instance.
requirements: p_codec must be valid.
p_callback must match typedef void (*)(const char*, void*).
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success; caller must check.

functions.name: opj_set_error_handler
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_error_handler(opj_codec_t * p_codec, opj_msg_callback p_callback, void * p_user_data);
functions.description: Registers an error-level message callback for a codec instance.
requirements: p_codec must be valid.
p_callback must match typedef void (*)(const char*, void*).
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success; caller must check.

functions.name: opj_create_decompress
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_codec_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_create_decompress(OPJ_CODEC_FORMAT format);
functions.description: Creates a decompressor handle for the specified codec format (J2K, JP2, JPT).
requirements: format must be a supported OPJ_CODEC_FORMAT value (OPJ_CODEC_J2K, OPJ_CODEC_JP2, OPJ_CODEC_JPT for read).
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.
Destroy with opj_destroy_codec.

functions.name: opj_destroy_codec
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_destroy_codec(opj_codec_t * p_codec);
functions.description: Destroys a compressor/decompressor handle created by opj_create_decompress or opj_create_compress.
requirements: p_codec may be NULL (unknown; safe to pass valid handles).
Do not use p_codec after destruction.

functions.name: opj_end_decompress
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_end_decompress(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_stream_t *p_stream);
functions.description: Reads after the codestream if necessary to finish decompression on the given stream and codec.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid decompressor.
p_stream must be a valid stream associated with this decoding session.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success; caller must check.

functions.name: opj_set_default_decoder_parameters
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_default_decoder_parameters(opj_dparameters_t *parameters);
functions.description: Initializes an opj_dparameters_t structure with default decompression parameters.
requirements: parameters must be a valid pointer to writable memory.

functions.name: opj_setup_decoder
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_setup_decoder(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_dparameters_t *parameters);
functions.description: Configures a decoder with user-provided decompression parameters and message handlers.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid decoder handle.
parameters must point to a properly initialized opj_dparameters_t (e.g., via opj_set_default_decoder_parameters).
Must be called before opj_read_header.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success; caller must check.

functions.name: opj_decoder_set_strict_mode
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_decoder_set_strict_mode(opj_codec_t *p_codec, OPJ_BOOL strict);
functions.description: Enables or disables strict decoding mode on a decoder. Strict mode fails on partial bitstreams and disables TPSOT fixing; non-strict tries to decode as much as possible and enables TPSOT fixing.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid decoder handle.
Call after opj_setup_decoder and before opj_read_header for predictable behavior (implied by typical setup flow).
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_codec_set_threads
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_codec_set_threads(opj_codec_t *p_codec, int num_threads);
functions.description: Allocates worker threads for the codec. Overrides OPJ_NUM_THREADS environment logic when called.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid compressor/decompressor.
Must be called after opj_setup_decoder() and before opj_read_header() on decode side, or after opj_setup_encoder() and before opj_start_compress() on encode side.
num_threads specifies the number of threads; if not called, defaults to main thread or environment variable.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_read_header
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_read_header(opj_stream_t *p_stream, opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_image_t **p_image);
functions.description: Parses and reads the main header of the codestream (and JP2 header if applicable) and initializes the output image structure with encoded image characteristics.
requirements: p_stream must be a valid input stream with callbacks set.
p_codec must be a configured decoder (opj_setup_decoder).
p_image must be a non-NULL pointer to receive an allocated opj_image_t*; caller must free with opj_image_destroy.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success; caller must check.

functions.name: opj_set_decoded_components
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_decoded_components(opj_codec_t *p_codec, OPJ_UINT32 numcomps, const OPJ_UINT32* comps_indices, OPJ_BOOL apply_color_transforms);
functions.description: Restricts the set of components to decode to the specified indices. Indices are relative to the codestream. Color/multi-component transforms must currently be disabled.
requirements: Must be called after opj_read_header().
comps_indices must point to an array of at least numcomps entries, with indices relative to the codestream starting at 0.
apply_color_transforms should be OPJ_FALSE; OPJ_TRUE will result in an error per docs.
Not to be used together with opj_decode_tile_data().
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_set_decode_area
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_decode_area(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_image_t* p_image, OPJ_INT32 p_start_x, OPJ_INT32 p_start_y, OPJ_INT32 p_end_x, OPJ_INT32 p_end_y);
functions.description: Defines a rectangular region of the image to decode, expressed in the reference grid (highest resolution). If all coordinates are 0, the whole image is decoded.
requirements: Call right after opj_read_header and before any tile header reading.
p_image must be the image returned by opj_read_header for this codec/stream.
Coordinates must be in image reference grid; end coordinates are exclusive/inclusive not specified; follow library expectations.
Generally should be followed by opj_decode() and the codec cannot be reused, except for single-tile images where multiple area/decode cycles are allowed.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_decode
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_decode(opj_codec_t *p_decompressor, opj_stream_t *p_stream, opj_image_t *p_image);
functions.description: Decodes an image from a JPEG 2000 stream into the provided image structure.
requirements: p_decompressor must be a valid decoder configured via opj_setup_decoder and opj_read_header executed prior.
p_stream must be a valid input stream positioned for decoding.
p_image must be the image obtained from opj_read_header (possibly with region restrictions via opj_set_decode_area).
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_get_decoded_tile
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_get_decoded_tile(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_stream_t *p_stream, opj_image_t *p_image, OPJ_UINT32 tile_index);
functions.description: Decodes and retrieves a specific tile into the output image.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid decoder.
p_stream must be a valid input stream.
p_image must be allocated appropriately to receive tile data.
tile_index selects which tile to decode; range depends on codestream.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_set_decoded_resolution_factor
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_decoded_resolution_factor(opj_codec_t *p_codec, OPJ_UINT32 res_factor);
functions.description: Sets a resolution reduction factor for decoding (decode at lower resolution).
requirements: p_codec must be a valid decoder.
res_factor is the number of highest resolution levels to discard; valid range depends on codestream (limited by smallest number of decompositions).
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_write_tile
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_write_tile(opj_codec_t *p_codec, OPJ_UINT32 p_tile_index, OPJ_BYTE * p_data, OPJ_UINT32 p_data_size, opj_stream_t *p_stream);
functions.description: Writes one tile of image data to the stream for encoding. Data layout is non-interleaved by component (comp0, then comp1, ...).
requirements: Tiles must be written in sequence from 0 to n-1.
p_data_size must equal the sum over components of tile_width * tile_height * component_size, where component_size is 1, 2 or 4 bytes depending on component precision.
p_data must point to at least p_data_size bytes of valid data in required order (no interleaving).
p_codec must be a valid encoder in a compression session.
p_stream must be a valid output stream.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_read_tile_header
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_read_tile_header(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_stream_t * p_stream, OPJ_UINT32 * p_tile_index, OPJ_UINT32 * p_data_size, OPJ_INT32 * p_tile_x0, OPJ_INT32 * p_tile_y0, OPJ_INT32 * p_tile_x1, OPJ_INT32 * p_tile_y1, OPJ_UINT32 * p_nb_comps, OPJ_BOOL * p_should_go_on);
functions.description: Reads the next tile header and reports tile index, bounds, component count, and the maximum size of the decoded tile data. Indicates whether decoding should continue.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid decoder.
p_stream must be a valid input stream.
All output pointers must be non-NULL to receive data: p_tile_index, p_data_size, p_tile_x0, p_tile_y0, p_tile_x1, p_tile_y1, p_nb_comps, p_should_go_on.
On truncated codestreams, actual decoded bytes may be less than p_data_size.
Returns OPJ_TRUE if header was read; also OPJ_TRUE when decoding should end, indicated by *p_should_go_on == OPJ_FALSE.

functions.name: opj_decode_tile_data
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_decode_tile_data(opj_codec_t *p_codec, OPJ_UINT32 p_tile_index, OPJ_BYTE * p_data, OPJ_UINT32 p_data_size, opj_stream_t *p_stream);
functions.description: Decodes tile data for the given tile index into the provided buffer. Must be preceded by opj_read_tile_header.
requirements: Do not use together with opj_set_decoded_components().
p_codec must be a valid decoder.
p_tile_index must match the most recent value provided by opj_read_tile_header.
p_data must have capacity of at least p_data_size bytes; p_data_size should be >= size indicated by opj_read_tile_header.
p_stream must be a valid input stream.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_create_compress
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_codec_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_create_compress(OPJ_CODEC_FORMAT format);
functions.description: Creates a compressor handle for the specified codec format (e.g., J2K or JP2).
requirements: format must be a supported OPJ_CODEC_FORMAT value for writing.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check.
Destroy with opj_destroy_codec.

functions.name: opj_set_default_encoder_parameters
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_default_encoder_parameters(opj_cparameters_t *parameters);
functions.description: Initializes an opj_cparameters_t structure with default encoding parameters (lossless, 1 tile, 64x64 code-blocks, 6 resolutions, LRCP, etc.).
requirements: parameters must be a valid pointer to writable memory.

functions.name: opj_setup_encoder
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_setup_encoder(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_cparameters_t *parameters, opj_image_t *image);
functions.description: Configures the encoder with user-provided parameters based on the provided input image.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid encoder handle.
parameters must point to a properly initialized opj_cparameters_t (e.g., via opj_set_default_encoder_parameters).
image must be a valid, fully specified opj_image_t matching the intended encoding.
Must be called before opj_start_compress or opj_encode.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_encoder_set_extra_options
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_encoder_set_extra_options(opj_codec_t *p_codec, const char* const* p_options);
functions.description: Provides extra encoding options in a key=value string array, currently supporting PLT, TLM, and GUARD_BITS settings.
requirements: May be called after opj_setup_encoder() and before opj_start_compress().
p_codec must be a valid encoder.
p_options must be a NULL-terminated array of strings of the form KEY=VALUE. Recognized keys: PLT=YES/NO, TLM=YES/NO, GUARD_BITS=value(0..7).
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_start_compress
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_start_compress(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_image_t * p_image, opj_stream_t *p_stream);
functions.description: Begins an encoding session for the provided image and output stream.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid encoder configured via opj_setup_encoder.
p_image must be the input image to encode.
p_stream must be a valid output stream.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_end_compress
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_end_compress(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_stream_t *p_stream);
functions.description: Ends the current encoding session, flushing any remaining data to the stream.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid encoder.
p_stream must be the associated output stream.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_encode
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_encode(opj_codec_t *p_codec, opj_stream_t *p_stream);
functions.description: Encodes the image previously set up into the output stream (non-tiled or library-managed tiling flows).
requirements: p_codec must be a valid encoder configured via opj_setup_encoder (and potentially opj_start_compress if using the start/end API).
p_stream must be a valid output stream.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

functions.name: opj_destroy_cstr_info
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_destroy_cstr_info(opj_codestream_info_v2_t **cstr_info);
functions.description: Destroys and frees a codestream info structure previously obtained from the codec.
requirements: *cstr_info must be a pointer previously returned by opj_get_cstr_info (or NULL).
Pass the address of the pointer (double pointer).
After return, the pointed-to resource is freed; do not reuse.

functions.name: opj_dump_codec
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_dump_codec(opj_codec_t *p_codec, OPJ_INT32 info_flag, FILE* output_stream);
functions.description: Dumps codec information to the given FILE* according to the info_flag bitmask.
requirements: p_codec must be a valid codec handle.
output_stream must be a valid FILE* opened for writing.
info_flag controls what is dumped; see OPJ_IMG_INFO/OPJ_J2K_* flags.

functions.name: opj_get_cstr_info
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_codestream_info_v2_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_get_cstr_info(opj_codec_t *p_codec);
functions.description: Retrieves codestream information from the codec.
requirements: p_codec must be valid.
Returns a pointer to an info structure or NULL on failure; caller must eventually free it with opj_destroy_cstr_info.

functions.name: opj_get_cstr_index
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_codestream_index_t * OPJ_CALLCONV opj_get_cstr_index(opj_codec_t *p_codec);
functions.description: Retrieves the codestream index from the codec.
requirements: p_codec must be valid.
Returns a pointer to an index structure or NULL on failure; free with opj_destroy_cstr_index.

functions.name: opj_destroy_cstr_index
functions.signature: OPJ_API void OPJ_CALLCONV opj_destroy_cstr_index(opj_codestream_index_t **p_cstr_index);
functions.description: Destroys and frees a codestream index structure previously obtained from the codec.
requirements: *p_cstr_index must be a pointer previously returned by opj_get_cstr_index (or NULL).
Pass the address of the pointer (double pointer).
After return, the pointed-to resource is freed; do not reuse.

functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_jp2_metadata_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_get_jp2_metadata(opj_codec_t *p_codec);
functions.description: Retrieves JP2 file metadata structure from the codec (experimental/placeholder).
requirements: p_codec must be valid.
Returns a pointer to a metadata structure or NULL on failure; lifetime/ownership not fully specified in header (unknown details).

functions.name: opj_get_jp2_index
functions.signature: OPJ_API opj_jp2_index_t* OPJ_CALLCONV opj_get_jp2_index(opj_codec_t *p_codec);
functions.description: Retrieves JP2 file index structure from the codec (experimental/placeholder).
requirements: p_codec must be valid.
Returns a pointer to an index structure or NULL on failure; ownership/cleanup semantics not detailed in header (unknown).

functions.name: opj_set_MCT
functions.signature: OPJ_API OPJ_BOOL OPJ_CALLCONV opj_set_MCT(opj_cparameters_t *parameters, OPJ_FLOAT32 * pEncodingMatrix, OPJ_INT32 * p_dc_shift, OPJ_UINT32 pNbComp);
functions.description: Sets a custom Multiple Component Transform (MCT) matrix and DC shift for encoding parameters.
requirements: parameters must be a valid encoder parameter structure.
pEncodingMatrix must point to a matrix compatible with pNbComp (size/layout not specified in header; follow library expectations).
p_dc_shift must point to an array of at least pNbComp integers.
pNbComp must match the number of image components.
Returns OPJ_TRUE on success.

data_types.description: Binary data representing a JPEG 2000 image container: either a raw J2K codestream (e.g., magic SOC 0xFF4F) or a JP2/JPX/related file format containing a JPEG 2000 codestream (e.g., JP2 with magic 'ftypjp2'). The data is read from a file path and consumed by OpenJPEG stream APIs for decoding/processing.

import io
import random
import struct
from typing import List

# Utility big-endian packers

def _u16(x: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack(">H", x & 0xFFFF)


def _u32(x: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack(">I", x & 0xFFFFFFFF)


# JP2 box builder

def _box(box_type: bytes, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    return _u32(8 + len(payload)) + box_type + payload


# Build a minimal-but-valid raw J2K codestream with some variability

def _build_min_j2k(width: int, height: int, num_decomp: int, cb_log2: int, prog_lr_is_lrcp: bool) -> bytes:
    # Markers
    SOC = b"\xFF\x4F"
    SIZ = b"\xFF\x51"
    COD = b"\xFF\x52"
    QCD = b"\xFF\x5C"
    SOT = b"\xFF\x90"
    SOD = b"\xFF\x93"
    EOC = b"\xFF\xD9"

    # SIZ segment: single component, 8-bit unsigned
    Rsiz = 0
    Xsiz = width
    Ysiz = height
    X0 = 0
    Y0 = 0
    XTsiz = width
    YTsiz = height
    XT0 = 0
    YT0 = 0
    Csiz = 1
    ssiz = 7  # 8-bit unsigned (precision-1 + sign bit)
    XRsiz = 1
    YRsiz = 1

    siz_payload = (
        _u16(Rsiz)
        + _u32(Xsiz)
        + _u32(Ysiz)
        + _u32(X0)
        + _u32(Y0)
        + _u32(XTsiz)
        + _u32(YTsiz)
        + _u32(XT0)
        + _u32(YT0)
        + _u16(Csiz)
        + bytes([ssiz, XRsiz, YRsiz])
    )
    siz = SIZ + _u16(2 + len(siz_payload)) + siz_payload

    # COD (coding style default)
    Scod = 0  # no SOP/EPH, no precincts
    SGcod_prog = 0 if prog_lr_is_lrcp else 1  # 0: LRCP, 1: RLCP
    SGcod_nl = max(0, min(6, num_decomp))  # 0..6
    SGcod_xcb = max(4, min(7, cb_log2))  # 16..128
    SGcod_ycb = max(4, min(7, cb_log2))
    SGcod_mct = 0
    cod_payload = bytes([
        Scod,
        SGcod_prog,
        SGcod_nl,
        SGcod_xcb,
        SGcod_ycb,
        SGcod_mct,
    ])
    cod = COD + _u16(2 + len(cod_payload)) + cod_payload

    # QCD: no quantization (reversible). Steps = 1 byte per subband: 3*NL+1 bands
    Sqcd = 0x00
    nbands = 3 * SGcod_nl + 1
    steps = bytes([0x0F] * nbands)
    qcd_payload = bytes([Sqcd]) + steps
    qcd = QCD + _u16(2 + len(qcd_payload)) + qcd_payload

    # Single tile-part with tiny payload
    Isot = 0
    TPsot = 0
    TNsot = 1

    # Create a small synthetic payload with some variability but valid framing
    # We'll place a couple of non-0xFF bytes to avoid accidental marker parsing.
    tile_payload = b"RAW" + bytes([(width ^ height) & 0xFF, (nbands * 7) & 0xFF])

    # Psot = bytes from SOT marker to end of this tile-part (includes SOT segment and following data SOD+payload)
    psot = 12 + 2 + len(tile_payload)
    sot = SOT + _u16(10) + _u16(Isot) + _u32(psot) + bytes([TPsot, TNsot])
    sod = SOD

    return SOC + siz + cod + qcd + sot + sod + tile_payload + EOC


# Build a minimal JP2 file wrapping a J2K codestream

def _build_min_jp2(width: int, height: int, comps: int) -> bytes:
    # Signature and file type
    jp2_sig = _box(b"jP  ", b"\x0D\x0A\x87\x0A")
    ftyp = _box(b"ftyp", b"jp2 \x00\x00\x00\x00jp2 jpx ")  # include jpx compatibility occasionally

    # ihdr
    bpc = 7  # 8-bit unsigned
    compression = 7
    unk_color = 0
    ipr = 0
    ihdr_payload = _u32(height) + _u32(width) + _u16(comps) + bytes([bpc, compression, unk_color, ipr])
    ihdr = _box(b"ihdr", ihdr_payload)

    # colr (enumerated)
    if comps == 1:
        enumcs = 17  # greyscale
    else:
        enumcs = 16  # sRGB
    colr_payload = bytes([1, 0, 0]) + _u32(enumcs)
    colr = _box(b"colr", colr_payload)

    jp2h = _box(b"jp2h", ihdr + colr)

    # Codestream
    # pick some variability for the embedded J2K
    j2k = _build_min_j2k(width, height, num_decomp=max(0, min(6, (width ^ height) % 6)), cb_log2=6, prog_lr_is_lrcp=((width + height) % 2 == 0))
    jp2c = _box(b"jp2c", j2k)

    return jp2_sig + ftyp + jp2h + jp2c


def _choose_valid(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)

    # Randomly choose container kind with bias towards JP2
    kind = rnd.choices(["jp2", "j2k"], weights=[3, 1])[0]

    # Diverse dimensions within sane small ranges
    w = rnd.choice([8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48, 64])
    h = rnd.choice([8, 10, 14, 16, 18, 24, 32, 36, 48, 64])

    if kind == "j2k":
        # Add variability in progression, decomposition levels and code-block size
        nl = rnd.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
        cb = rnd.choice([4, 5, 6, 7])  # 16, 32, 64, 128
        prog_lrcp = rnd.choice([True, False])
        return _build_min_j2k(w, h, nl, cb, prog_lrcp)
    else:
        comps = rnd.choices([1, 3], weights=[2, 3])[0]
        return _build_min_jp2(w, h, comps)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    data = _choose_valid(seed)
    if len(data) > 4096:
        return data[:4096]
    return data
